questions.e: Effective the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026, banks must maintain at least 99% of prescribed CRR each day (average fortnightly requirement remains 3% of NDTL).

questions.subject: RBI
questions.q: The RBI's 13 October 2026 OMO sale of Rs 25,000 crore was conducted through which auction format?
questions.e: The 13 October 2026 OMO sale of government securities (maturing 2030-2034) used a multiple-price auction; the RBI may accept bids for less or more than the notified amount.

questions.subject: RBI
questions.q: The RBI excluded Paytm Payments Bank from the Second Schedule of scheduled banks in 2026 under which provision?
o: Section 35A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949
Section 22 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949
questions.e: PPBL was excluded under Section 42(6)(b) of the RBI Act, 1934, after its banking licence was cancelled on 24 April 2026. In July 2026 the Delhi High Court ordered its winding up and appointed former SBI CGM Girikumar M. Nair as Official Liquidator.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: After the RBI’s October 2026 policy, which rate forms the floor of the LAF corridor?
questions.e: The Standing Deposit Facility (5.25%) is the floor of the LAF corridor; the repo rate (5.50%) is the policy rate and the MSF (5.75%) is the ceiling.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: The RBI last raised the repo rate before October 2026 in which month?
questions.e: The October 2026 hike was the first since February 2023; the rate had been cut to 5.25% in December 2025 and held through 2026.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: The October 2026 decision to change the RBI’s stance to ‘calibrated tightening’ was taken by what vote?
questions.e: The stance change to calibrated tightening was decided 4–2, while the 25 bps repo hike itself was unanimous.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: What did the RBI announce about Account Aggregators in October 2026?
o: A new licence category for foreign AAs
Mandatory AA usage for all loans
questions.e: The RBI announced interoperability among NBFC-Account Aggregators, so customers can use any AA to share financial information across providers.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: What is the Bank Rate after the October 2026 monetary policy?
questions.e: The Bank Rate was revised to 5.75%, in line with the MSF rate, after the repo rate moved to 5.50%.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: When was the CAIIB May/June 2026 cycle result declared?
questions.e: Declared on 11 September 2026 via the IIBF Digital Candidate Portal.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: On which date is the JAIIB November 2026 PPB paper scheduled?
questions.e: PPB on 22 November; IE and IFS on 1 Nov, AFM on 28 Nov, RBWM on 29 Nov 2026.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: What are the qualifying marks per subject in CAIIB?
questions.e: 50 out of 100 in each subject.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: During which window were JAIIB November 2026 registrations open?
questions.e: Registrations were open 1-21 August 2026 with different fee slabs.

questions.subject: RBI Policy
questions.q: Amid hardening inflation, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points (reported week of 9 October 2026). The new policy rate is:
questions.e: The MPC hiked the benchmark rate 25 bps to 5.50% as WPI inflation hit 11.39% and CPI inflation a 23-month high of 5.54% in September 2026.

questions.subject: Regulatory framework
questions.q: The approved sale of 60.72% of IDBI Bank to Fairfax for Rs. 52,878 crore, reducing the government's stake to 15%, is an example of:
questions.e: It is a strategic disinvestment: the government sells a controlling stake (60.72%) to a private buyer, retaining only 15% (LIC retains 19%).

questions.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
questions.q: With reference to the RBI's October 2026 monetary policy, match the instrument to its revised rate: (A) Repo rate, (B) SDF rate, (C) MSF/Bank Rate.
questions.e: Repo 5.50%, SDF 5.25%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.75% after the 25 bps hike on 7 October 2026; the MPC shifted stance to 'calibrated tightening'. (Dated: 7 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
questions.q: Under the revised October 2026 requirement, banks must maintain at least ___ of their prescribed CRR on each day of the reporting fortnight, with the average not falling below the prescribed requirement of 3%.
questions.e: The minimum daily CRR maintenance was raised to 99% effective from the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Banking Sector
questions.q: Fairfax Financial Holdings is acquiring a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank. Which committee of the Union Cabinet approved the transaction?
questions.e: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the ₹52,878 crore transaction — the largest financial-sector FDI deal in India. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Banking Sector
questions.q: Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) bonds, in the news over the Supreme Court's Yes Bank verdict, are best described as:
o: Perpetual capital instruments used by banks to shore up Tier-1 capital under Basel III
Equity shares issued at a discount
questions.e: AT-1 bonds are perpetual capital instruments that help banks meet Tier-1 capital norms under Basel III; the SC overturned the ₹8,415 crore AT-1 write-off at Yes Bank. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Financial Markets
questions.q: The RBI's ₹25,000 crore open market operation sale of government securities announced for 13 October 2026 is intended to:
o: Inject liquidity into the banking system
Absorb surplus liquidity from the banking system
questions.e: An OMO sale of securities absorbs surplus liquidity from the banking system, aligning overnight rates with the repo rate. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Banking Sector
questions.q: NABARD's October 2026 specialist recruitment (Advt No. 04) is for which of its functions?
o: CISO & DoS-CSITE — cyber security and IT
questions.e: The 16 posts are for CISO & DoS-CSITE (cyber security & IT) at Head Office, Mumbai, on contract. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: In October 2026 the RBI moved its monetary policy stance from 'neutral' to 'calibrated tightening'. This signals:
o: Further rate cuts are likely soon
Future action can only be a rate hike or a pause, depending on growth and inflation
The RBI will buy government securities
questions.e: Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated on 7 October 2026 that rate cuts are off the table in the near term and that future policy action can only be a rate hike or a pause depending on how growth and inflation evolve.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: Which of the following is the correct rate structure after the RBI's October 2026 policy?
questions.e: After the 25-bps hike on 7 October 2026: repo 5.50%, SDF 5.25% (repo minus 25 bps), MSF and Bank Rate 5.75% (repo plus 25 bps).

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: The October 2026 Supreme Court judgment in the Yes Bank AT-1 bonds case upheld:
o: The administrator's write-down of Rs. 8,415 crore
The Bombay High Court's setting aside of the Rs. 8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-down
RBI's power to write down AT-1 bonds without a scheme
The merger of the bondholders into equity
questions.e: The Supreme Court dismissed the appeals and left the Bombay High Court's decision — which set aside the Rs. 8,415 crore write-down — undisturbed, ruling that an administrator cannot exercise a power the framework assigns to the RBI.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: The Statutory Liquidity Ratio as of October 2026 was 18.00%. SLR assets are maintained by banks as a proportion of:
questions.e: Banks maintain SLR as a percentage of their Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) in liquid assets such as cash, gold and unencumbered government securities; it stood at 18.00% in October 2026.

questions.subject: RBI & Regulation
questions.q: Shri Sudhakar Malli was appointed RBI Executive Director with effect from 1 October 2026. Which department does he head?
o: Department of Payment and Settlement Systems
questions.e: RBI's press release of 2 October 2026 states that Shri Malli, previously CGM-in-Charge of the Department of Supervision, will look after the Department of Supervision (Supervisory Assessment).

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: The IIBF declared the JAIIB May 2026 cycle result on which date?
questions.e: IIBF declared the JAIIB May cycle result on 4 August 2026 (exams held 3, 9, 10 and 17 May 2026). The November 2026 JAIIB papers are scheduled for 1, 22, 28 and 29 November 2026.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: What is the passing criterion for the CAIIB examination conducted by IIBF?
o: 50 marks in each paper, or 45 per subject with 50% overall in a single attempt
Only the elective papers need 50 marks
questions.e: CAIIB requires 50 marks in each paper, or 45 marks per subject with 50% overall in a single attempt. Candidates get 5 attempts or 3 years, whichever is earlier; the certification is valid for life and IIBF issues only a digital certificate.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: The policy repo rate after the RBI's 7 October 2026 MPC decision is:
questions.e: The MPC raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%, the first hike since February 2023, shifting the stance to 'calibrated tightening'.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: Under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility, the rate at which the RBI borrows overnight from banks is the:
questions.e: The SDF rate (5.25% after the October 2026 hike) is the rate at which the RBI accepts uncollateralised overnight deposits from banks — the floor of the LAF corridor.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: On 15 October 2026 the Supreme Court, in 2026 INSC 1132, did what with the Rs 8,415 crore write-down of Yes Bank's AT-1 bonds?
o: Ordered a fresh write-down of Rs 4,000 crore
Referred the matter to the RBI
questions.e: The Court set aside the write-down, holding it could not be sustained once the final Reconstruction Scheme omitted a write-down provision.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: Each JAIIB paper carries 100 marks. What is the minimum score to pass a paper?
questions.e: JAIIB papers carry 100 marks (100 MCQs, 2 hours, no negative marking) and the qualifying mark is 50 out of 100.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: Which of the following is offered as a CAIIB elective paper?
questions.e: CAIIB electives include Risk Management (alongside Rural Banking, HRM, IT & Digital Banking and Central Banking). Retail Banking and PPB are JAIIB papers; IE&IFS is also a JAIIB paper.

questions.subject: Banking
questions.q: A 25-basis-point hike in the policy repo rate equals an increase of:
questions.e: One basis point is one-hundredth of a percentage point, so 25 bps = 0.25 percentage point. The October 2026 hike took the repo from 5.25% to 5.50%.

questions.subject: Banking
questions.q: After the October 2026 RBI policy, the MSF rate and the Bank Rate are:
questions.e: The 25 bps repo hike to 5.50% adjusted the MSF rate and Bank Rate to 5.75%, and the SDF to 5.25%.

questions.subject: Banking
questions.q: The October 2026 shift to 'calibrated tightening' was adopted on an MPC vote of:
questions.e: The stance change passed 4-2; Dr Nagesh Kumar and Prof Ram Singh favoured retaining 'neutral'. The 25 bps rate hike itself was unanimous.

questions.subject: Banking
questions.q: In the RBI's Liquidity Adjustment Facility corridor after October 2026, which rate forms the floor?
questions.e: The SDF at 5.25% is the floor of the LAF corridor; the repo (5.50%) is the policy rate in the middle; the MSF/Bank Rate (5.75%) form the ceiling.

questions.subject: Banking
questions.q: Who chaired the 63rd MPC meeting (5-7 October 2026) that raised the repo rate to 5.50%?
questions.e: The 63rd MPC meeting of 5-7 October 2026 was chaired by RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra, who announced the 25 bps hike and the shift to 'calibrated tightening'.

questions.subject: Financial Inclusion
questions.q: The Finance Ministry's financial inclusion saturation campaign (21 October - 31 December 2026) covers how many gram panchayats and urban local bodies?
questions.e: 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies; banks conduct camps for PMJJBY, PMSBY and APY enrolments, Aadhaar seeding and nomination updates.

questions.subject: Financial Inclusion
questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a focus of the 21 October - 31 December 2026 financial inclusion saturation campaign?
questions.e: The campaign covers PMJJBY/PMSBY/APY enrolments, Aadhaar seeding and nomination updates. Instant KYC-free loans are not part of the campaign.

questions.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
questions.q: With effect from the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026, scheduled banks must maintain a minimum daily CRR of:
questions.e: The RBI (9 Oct 2026 notification, Section 42(1) of the RBI Act, 1934) raised minimum daily CRR maintenance from 90% to 99% from the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026; the CRR rate itself remains 3%.

questions.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
questions.q: The FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026 came into force on:
questions.e: The Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026 came into force on 1 October 2026.

questions.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
questions.q: Under the FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026, AD banks must upload export/import data in EDPMS/IDPMS for non-EDI ports within:
questions.e: Under the new FEMA export-import regulations, AD banks must upload export and import data in EDPMS/IDPMS within 5 working days for non-EDI ports.

questions.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
questions.q: The RBI proposes to raise the aggregate ceiling on unsecured advances for Urban Co-operative Banks to:
questions.e: The RBI proposed doubling the UCB unsecured-advances ceiling from 10% to 20% of total assets (from 1 Oct 2026), with beyond-ceiling unsecured advances restricted to priority-sector loans up to Rs 50,000 per borrower.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: IFSCA Karmayogi, honoured at the 3rd World AI Summit (Bengaluru, 14-15 Oct 2026) with the 'Excellence in AI for Public Policy' award, was created in 2023 by whom?
questions.e: Dr. Hemant Garg, Deputy Director (Legal) at ESIC, created IFSCA Karmayogi in 2023 - the first AI agent at the International Financial Services Centres Authority, GIFT City - and researched AI in anti-money laundering and the Labour Codes.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: Who announced on 8 October 2026 that India will release a consultation paper on AI regulation within a month?
questions.e: Union Minister for Electronics and IT Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the AI regulation consultation paper, to focus on AI safety, deepfakes, skilling and a techno-legal framework.

questions.subject: Banking Certifications
questions.q: According to the IT Minister, what is 'the most important point' the upcoming AI regulation consultation paper will focus on?
questions.e: The Minister said safety related to AI use - including deepfakes, cybersecurity and psychological harms - is the most important point, with a human-first approach.

questions.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
questions.q: In the RBI's LAF corridor (Oct 2026: SDF 5.25%, MSF 5.75%), which statement is correct?
o: SDF is the ceiling, MSF the floor
SDF is the floor (no collateral needed); MSF is the ceiling
questions.e: The SDF (5.25%) is the floor of the LAF corridor — banks park surplus funds with the RBI without providing collateral (it replaced the fixed-rate reverse repo in April 2022). The MSF (5.75%) is the ceiling — overnight borrowing against SLR securities.

questions.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
questions.q: If the repo rate is 5.50%, what are the standard SDF and MSF rates?
questions.e: The corridor is symmetric: SDF = repo − 25 bps, MSF = repo + 25 bps. October 2026: repo 5.50% → SDF 5.25%, MSF 5.75%. JAIIB classic: a 25-bps repo hike moves the whole corridor up by 25 bps.

questions.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
questions.q: What does the October 2026 “calibrated tightening” stance imply for policy direction?
o: Rate cuts are off the table; next move is a hike or pause
The RBI will buy government bonds
questions.e: “Calibrated tightening” (adopted 4–2 in Oct 2026) means the RBI is withdrawing accommodation gradually: rate cuts are off the table, and the next move will be a hike or a pause depending on growth–inflation dynamics.

questions.subject: Banking Regulation
questions.q: What is the maximum deposit insurance cover per depositor per bank under DICGC?
questions.e: DICGC covers deposits up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor per bank (principal + interest), including co-operative banks. Banks pay the premium — 12 paise per ₹100 of assessable deposits per half-year.

questions.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
questions.q: What was the RBI's stated reason for the October 2026 rate hike?
o: Generalisation of inflation (37% of CPI basket above 4%)
questions.e: The October 2026 hike was driven by generalised inflation: 37% of CPI-basket commodities had inflation above 4% in August (vs 20% in March), CPI at 4.8%, crude $114–116/barrel, and a 13% monsoon deficit — i.e. supply-side and expectations risks, not overheating demand (Q1 FY27 GDP grew 7.8%).

questions.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
questions.q: How many members does the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee have?
questions.e: The MPC has six members — 3 RBI officials (Governor as chair, Deputy Governor, one RBI officer) and 3 external members appointed by the government. The October 2026 rate vote was unanimous; the stance vote was 4–2.

questions.subject: Basel III
questions.q: Under Basel III, the Capital Conservation Buffer (CCB) that banks must hold over and above the minimum capital requirement is:
questions.e: Basel III requires a Capital Conservation Buffer of 2.5% of risk-weighted assets (in Common Equity Tier 1) above the minimum CET1 + Tier 1 requirements.

questions.subject: Basel III
questions.q: The Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) under Basel III requires banks to hold high-quality liquid assets sufficient to cover net cash outflows over:
questions.e: The LCR covers a 30-day stress scenario; the Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) covers a one-year horizon.

questions.subject: Risk management
questions.q: Under RBI KYC norms, the risk categorisation of customers for periodic updation divides them into:
o: High, medium and low risk categories
questions.e: RBI's KYC directions require banks to categorise customers as low, medium or high risk and apply risk-based periodic updation.

questions.subject: Credit
questions.q: As per RBI's asset classification norms, a term loan account is classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) when interest or instalment remains overdue for more than:
questions.e: A term loan becomes an NPA when interest and/or instalment of principal remains overdue for more than 90 days.

questions.subject: Treasury
questions.q: Which of the following statements about CRR and SLR is correct?
o: SLR is maintained only in cash with RBI
CRR is maintained in cash with RBI and earns no interest; SLR can be held in cash, gold or approved securities
Both CRR and SLR earn the repo rate
questions.e: CRR is cash with RBI and earns no interest; SLR can be held by the bank itself in cash, gold or approved securities.

questions.subject: Banking
questions.q: What was the policy repo rate of the RBI after the October 2026 hike?
questions.e: The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% in October 2026, its first increase in about two and a half years.

questions.subject: Banking
questions.q: The prescribed Cash Reserve Ratio of scheduled banks, as of October 2026, is:
questions.e: The prescribed CRR is 3% of net demand and time liabilities; banks earn no interest on these balances with the RBI.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under the expanded Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (2026), the maximum guarantee cover per borrower is:
questions.e: The maximum CGSS cover was doubled from ₹10 crore to ₹20 crore per borrower, with 85% coverage for loans up to ₹10 crore and 75% beyond it.

questions.subject: Banking Awareness
questions.q: The RBI's October 2026 MPC minutes (released 22 October) state that future policy action will be:
o: either a rate hike or a pause, since rate cuts are off the table in the near term
a certain rate cut in December 2026
a return to the neutral stance
questions.e: The minutes state: 'given the current conditions, rate cuts are off the table in the near term and policy action ahead can only be a rate hike or a pause, depending on the evolving conditions and the outlook'.

questions.subject: Banking Awareness
questions.q: What was the voting pattern on the policy stance at the October 2026 MPC?
o: 4-2 in favour of shifting to 'calibrated tightening'
questions.e: The 25 bps hike itself was unanimous, but the shift from 'neutral' to 'calibrated tightening' was carried 4-2 — two members preferred retaining the neutral stance.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: After the RBI's 7 October 2026 policy, the floor of the LAF corridor (SDF rate) is:
questions.e: 5.25% — SDF is the floor; MSF/Bank Rate (5.75%) is the ceiling.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: The Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) after the RBI's October 2026 policy stands at:
questions.e: 3% — unchanged; there was no liquidity squeeze from the CRR side.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: Under the Supreme Court's 15 October 2026 IBC ruling, what must be proved to admit a company into CIRP?
o: The exact quantum of outstanding debt
questions.e: The occurrence of default — a static historical event. Profitability (EBITDA) is no ground to stall admission, and disputes over the exact debt quantum do not negate default if the Section 4 threshold is met.

questions.subject: AML / KYC
questions.q: TRAI's October 2026 move allowing banks to use 1600-series numbers for two-way communication primarily helps with:
o: Identifying genuine banking calls and curbing vishing fraud
questions.e: Identifying genuine banking calls — customers can distinguish real bank calls from fraudsters (vishing).

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: After the 7 October 2026 policy, the Bank Rate stands at:
questions.e: 5.75% — the Bank Rate moves with the MSF rate, which is the ceiling of the LAF corridor.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: In October 2026 the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the sale of what percentage of IDBI Bank's stake to Fairfax, and for what value?
questions.e: CCEA approved the 60.72% IDBI Bank stake sale to Fairfax for Rs 52,878.08 crore on 14 October 2026, reported as set to be the largest FDI in India's financial sector.

questions.subject: Risk Management
questions.q: When the RBI raises the repo rate, which of the following loan categories adjusts first at its next reset?
questions.e: Since 2019, many floating-rate loans must be linked to an external benchmark such as the repo rate, so they reset after a policy change; the October 2026 hike to 5.50% is the live example.

questions.subject: Banking Regulation
questions.q: The October 2026 IDBI Bank stake sale approved by the CCEA involved what percentage of the bank's equity going to Fairfax?
questions.e: The CCEA approved a 60.72% IDBI Bank stake sale to Fairfax for Rs 52,878.08 crore on 14 October 2026.

questions.subject: Banking Regulation
questions.q: Under the 57th GST Council decisions of 8 October 2026, the general penalty under GST was reduced from Rs 25,000 to what amount?
questions.e: The Council cut the general penalty from Rs 25,000 to Rs 10,000, raised the prosecution threshold to Rs 5 crore, and removed GST officers' arrest powers.

questions.subject: Banking Awareness
questions.q: Which new reserve requirement did the RBI introduce on 10 October 2026 for specified rupee derivatives?
questions.e: The Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve (FERR), introduced on 10 October 2026, requires authorised dealers to maintain cash with the RBI equal to 20% of the INR-equivalent notional of qualifying rupee derivatives above USD 2 million equivalent that hedge current-account exposures.

questions.subject: Banking Awareness
questions.q: A 'calibrated tightening' stance adopted by the RBI in October 2026 signals which of the following?
o: Rate cuts are the likely next move
Further rate hikes are possible but gradual, and rate cuts are off the table for now
The repo rate is linked to the exchange rate
questions.e: Calibrated tightening means the RBI leans towards tighter policy: rate cuts are not under consideration in the current cycle, while any further hikes would be gradual and measured, decided on incoming inflation and growth data.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: What did the RBI change about CRR maintenance in October 2026?
o: The daily CRR floor was raised to 99 per cent
The CRR rate itself was raised to 99 per cent
Banks were exempted from CRR for a fortnight
The CRR rate was cut to 2 per cent
questions.e: The daily floor rose from 90 per cent to 99 per cent of the prescribed CRR from the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026; the fortnight-average requirement stayed at 3 per cent.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: Which instrument did the RBI use in October 2026 to restrain speculative dollar buying?
o: A 5 per cent margin on all imports
A ban on hedging by exporters
A cap on banks' dollar holdings
A 20 per cent cash reserve requirement on FX derivatives
questions.e: The RBI first imposed a 20 per cent cash reserve requirement on banks for client FX derivatives hedging current-account exposures, then extended it to all rupee-linked FX derivatives where banks buy foreign currency against the rupee to hedge their own assets and liabilities.

questions.subject: Current affairs
questions.q: Who jointly secured All India Rank 1 in the ICAI CA Intermediate September 2026 examination, declared on 22 October 2026?
o: Neel Rajesh Shah (Mumbai) and Chandak Sakshi (Nashik)
Neel Rajesh Shah (Mumbai) and Shruti V (Chennai)
questions.e: Both scored 502 marks out of 600 (83.67%). Shruti V of Chennai was second with 492 marks (82%) and Prem Agarwal of Surat third with 490 (81.67%).

questions.subject: Current affairs
questions.q: What was the pass percentage for Group I of the ICAI CA Intermediate September 2026 examination?
questions.e: Of 1,00,301 candidates who appeared for Group I, 23,210 passed. Group II recorded 18.92% and candidates appearing for both groups recorded 13.21%.

questions.subject: Accountancy
questions.q: To pass a group of the CA Intermediate examination, a candidate must secure what minimum marks?
o: 40% in each paper and 50% aggregate in the group
questions.e: The rule stated with the September 2026 results is a minimum of 40 marks out of 100 in each paper and at least 50% aggregate marks in each group.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: By when will the RBI's October 2026 account-aggregator interoperability measure be implemented?
questions.e: Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the interoperability measure and the extended consolidated account statement would be implemented by the end of 2026.

questions.subject: Regulation
questions.q: The FSDC's mandate does NOT include which of the following?
questions.e: The FSDC's mandate covers financial stability, financial sector development, inter-regulatory coordination, financial inclusion, financial literacy and macro-prudential supervision, including risks from large financial conglomerates. Tax rates are outside its remit.

questions.subject: Markets
questions.q: A Treasury Bill auction notified by RBI for 28 October 2026 comprised ₹23,000 crore in which split?
questions.e: The 28 October 2026 T-Bill auction comprised ₹8,000 crore each of 91-day and 182-day bills and ₹7,000 crore of 364-day bills, price-based under the multiple price method, with retail non-competitive allocation capped at 5% via RBI Retail Direct.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: Under the RBI's October 2026 change, a bank must maintain at least what share of its prescribed CRR on each day of the reporting fortnight?
questions.e: Daily CRR maintenance was raised from 90% to 99% of the prescribed requirement; the CRR rate itself stayed at 3%.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: As on 30 September 2026, year-on-year growth in bank credit was 19.4% and in deposits was:
questions.e: RBI data reported on 16 October 2026 put credit growth at 19.4% and deposit growth at 17.8% year-on-year.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: The WTO's revised outlook projected world merchandise trade volume growth of 3.1% for which year?
questions.e: The projection in the WTO's revised Global Trade Outlook, reported in October 2026, was for 2026.

questions.subject: Banking Awareness
questions.q: Under the Mahatma Gandhi (New) Series, which of the following denominations is NOT currently in active circulation?
questions.e: The Rs 1,000 denomination ceased to be legal tender on 8 November 2016. The series currently circulates Rs 10, Rs 20, Rs 50, Rs 100, Rs 200 and Rs 500 notes.

questions.subject: Banking Awareness
questions.q: PIB Fact Check's 27 October 2026 clarification about the viral Rs 1,000 note illustrates which good practice for banks and customers?
o: Verify currency news only through official RBI and government sources before acting or sharing
Accept social media images of new notes as genuine
Report every currency image to a bank branch
questions.e: PIB Fact Check urged verification through official sources and warned against sharing unverified claims; the RBI communicates currency decisions through official notifications and press releases.

questions.subject: Risk Management
questions.q: In the forthcoming AI regulation consultation paper, experts have urged which safeguards for AI agents in sensitive areas such as banking?
o: Human control, audit trails and clear accountability with incident reporting
Complete removal of all human oversight
No audit trails for faster processing
Banning all AI use in banking
questions.e: Experts urged human control over AI, audit trails, ways to fix things if something goes wrong, clear accountability systems and incident-reporting mechanisms, especially in sensitive areas like banking.

questions.subject: Banking Awareness
questions.q: The Supreme Court's 27 October 2026 hearing on medicine pricing recorded that the Centre had capped the trade margin on cancer drugs at 30% of MRP. What does MRP stand for in this context?
questions.e: MRP is the Maximum Retail Price printed on the pack; the cap limits the trade margin to 30% of that price for the listed cancer drugs.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: From the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026, banks must maintain at least what percentage of their prescribed cash reserve ratio requirement on each day, up from 90%?
questions.e: The Reserve Bank of India raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance to 99% of the requirement. The average daily CRR over the fortnight must still be at least the prescribed 3%, and banks earn no interest on CRR balances.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: Which factor was cited in October 2026 as the main reason for the sharp fall in the banking system's liquidity surplus that prompted variable-rate repo operations by the Reserve Bank of India?
o: Outflows for Goods and Services Tax payments
A cut in the repo rate
A fall in currency in circulation
questions.e: An ICICI Bank report attributed the fall to GST payment outflows and higher cash reserve requirements. The surplus fell to about Rs 50,000 crore as of 23 October 2026, and the weekly average call rate rose to 5.70% from 5.48%.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: Between 1 and 16 October 2026 the Reserve Bank of India's net dollar sales through spot and forward markets were reported at $18.2 billion. What was the rupee's approximate movement after the RBI's 10 October measures, from 96.73 per dollar on 9 October?
o: It appreciated to an intraday high of 94.33 on 23 October
questions.e: Reports based on economists' and traders' data put net sales at $18.2 billion for 1-16 October, the highest monthly selling in 2026 so far. The rupee appreciated about 2.4% from 96.73 on 9 October to an intraday high of 94.33 on 23 October, before giving up some gains as crude oil prices rose.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: The Cash Reserve Ratio is the proportion of a bank's net demand and time liabilities that must be kept with the RBI. Which statement about the October 2026 change is correct?
o: The CRR rate was raised from 3% to 3.99%
The daily minimum maintenance rose from 90% to 99% of the requirement; the CRR rate stayed at 3%
The fortnightly average requirement was abolished
questions.e: The RBI notification raised only the minimum daily maintenance, effective from the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026; CRR balances earn no interest.

questions.subject: CAIIB
questions.q: A bank that previously maintained 90% of CRR on seven days and 110% on the next seven days of a fortnight complied on average. Under the 99% daily rule, the main effect is:
questions.e: Treasury heads quoted in October 2026 said banks would mostly have to maintain close to 100% at all times, removing operational flexibility.

questions.subject: JAIIB
questions.q: The RBI aimed to bring the weighted average call rate (WACR) closer to the policy repo rate of 5.50%. WACR is:
o: The operating target of monetary policy in the overnight money market
The prime lending rate of SBI
questions.e: Reports noted the WACR averaged 14 basis points below the repo rate since the August policy review and stood at 5.31% on the Friday reported.

questions.subject: AML / KYC
questions.q: Which of the following October 2026 developments is most relevant to a bank's liquidity and treasury operations?
o: RBI raising daily CRR maintenance to 99%
Discovery of a new electric ray
questions.e: The CRR change directly affects daily reserve balances and money-market conditions; the other items are defence, science and diplomacy news.

questions.subject: Basel III
questions.q: Under Basel III, the minimum Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio is 4.5 per cent of risk-weighted assets. With the full 2.5 per cent capital conservation buffer, what is the effective CET1 requirement?
questions.e: Minimum CET1 is 4.5 per cent plus the 2.5 per cent capital conservation buffer, giving an effective 7.0 per cent; total capital including the buffer is 10.5 per cent (8 per cent minimum plus 2.5 per cent buffer).

questions.subject: AML / KYC
questions.q: The RBI's proposed KYC Amendment Directions, 2026, discussed by the Supreme Court on 29 October 2026, must include enforceable provisions on compensation, prevention and institutional accountability for which category of crime?
o: Digital arrest and cyber-enabled financial fraud
questions.e: The Supreme Court, hearing a suo motu matter on digital arrest scams and cyber-enabled financial crimes, said the framework must mandate indemnity for victims of digital arrest or cyber fraud where due-diligence failure is found, plus preventive intervention such as suspending unusual transactions and automated reporting of suspicious activity.

questions.subject: Banking Regulation
questions.q: The Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) requires banks to hold high-quality liquid assets sufficient to cover net cash outflows over what stress horizon?
questions.e: The LCR is a 30-calendar-day stress horizon: HQLA must be at least 100 per cent of total net cash outflows over 30 days. The Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) covers a one-year horizon.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Payments snapshot (Sep 2026): UPI (2016) dominates retail; NEFT 24x7 since Dec 2019, RTGS 24x7 since Dec 2020 (min Rs. 2 lakh); IMPS (2010) was the instant-payments pioneer.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: UPI evolution (as of Sep 2026): UPI Lite for small offline-capable payments, 123Pay for feature phones, *99# USSD banking, Tap & Pay PIN-free NFC up to Rs. 5,000, MyUPI's unified dashboard with Safety Switch, and FiMI — NPCI's Finance Model for India small language model powering AI customer support.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Crypto-agility watch: AES-256 remains the symmetric standard; DES (56-bit) and MD5 are broken/retired; IDRBT research covers quantum-safe migration for a post-RSA/ECC future.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: IS audit toolkit recap: risk-based planning, CAATs for 100% population testing, test-data technique, parallel simulation, embedded audit modules, and the three-lines-of-defence model (audit = third line).

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Governance frameworks map: COBIT (ISACA) = IT governance; ITIL = service management; ISO 27001:2022 = ISMS; NIST CSF 2.0 = Govern/Identify/Protect/Detect/Respond/Recover; PCI DSS = card data; ISO 22301 = business continuity.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: BCP/DR numbers to memorise: RTO = max downtime; RPO = max data loss in time; MTD = survival deadline; 3-2-1 backup rule; hot = live failover, warm = hardware ready, cold = space only.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Fraud-pattern watch: SIM-swap (sudden signal loss = warning), phishing/vishing/smishing, UPI collect-request frauds, mule accounts — cooling periods and device binding are the standard technical counters.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: CBS exam anchors: Finacle/BaNCS/Flexcube platforms, CIF single customer view, maker-checker, three-tier architecture, OLTP vs warehouse/OLAP split, ADF returns straight from source systems.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Legal quick-map: Sec 43 (civil) vs Sec 66 (criminal hacking); 66C identity theft; 66D online personation; 66F cyber terrorism; 69/69A/69B interception-blocking-monitoring; 79 safe harbour; DPDP consent + Board + Rs. 250 cr penalties.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Study strategy: CISB rewards precise recall of dates, sections, ports, limits and committee names — drill the one-liners daily, then attempt the 250 MCQs in timed 2-hour blocks mirroring the real exam.
