capsules.body: FEDAI updated forex market-conduct guidance; exchange-margin norms unchanged in structure.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: RBI's June-2025 KYC relaxations (BC self-declarations, reminder regime) took effect from 1 January 2026 — low-risk grace runs to 30 June 2026.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: Sanjay Malhotra took charge as the 26th RBI Governor on 11 December 2024 for a three-year term.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.body: D-SIB list: SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank — additional CET1 surcharges by bucket.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: RBI mandated CDD at the UCIC (Unique Customer Identification Code) level — one consistent KYC view of a customer across all relationships.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: MUDRA 'Tarun Plus' (Rs 10–20 lakh) effective 24 October 2024 for entrepreneurs who repaid a Tarun loan; CGFMU cover raised to Rs 20 lakh.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: MUDRA's Tarun Plus category (₹10–₹20 lakh) opened for borrowers who successfully repaid a Tarun loan.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: RBI raised the bulk-deposit threshold from Rs 2 crore to Rs 3 crore for SCBs (excl. RRBs) and SFBs on 7 June 2024.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: India's FATF mutual evaluation (2024) placed the country on regular follow-up — a strong effectiveness verdict for the AML/CFT regime.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: CKYC Operating Guidelines v1.5 (Dec 2025) formalised upload, download and dissemination duties for the Central KYC Records Registry run by CERSAI.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: RBI issued the Master Direction on IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance on 7 November 2023 — five focus areas, effective 1 April 2024. Data migration policy, audit trails and crypto controls are headline requirements.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 received Presidential assent on 11 August 2023 (Act No. 22 of 2023) — Data Principals, Fiduciaries, consent rules, Board adjudication, penalties up to Rs. 250 crore.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 was enacted, governing banks' handling of personal data.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: S.O. 2036(E): practising chartered accountants, company secretaries and cost accountants brought under PMLA for five specified client financial transactions.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: S.O. 1072(E): five categories of virtual digital asset activity brought under PMLA; VDA service providers (including offshore ones serving India) must register with FIU-IND.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: PML Rules amendments defined politically exposed persons (PEPs) and non-profit organisations (NPOs), tightening EDD and NPO due-diligence duties.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: RBI launched the retail CBDC (e-rupee) pilot on 1 December 2022, following the wholesale pilot in November 2022 — sovereign digital currency being tested alongside UPI.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: Supreme Court in Vijay Madanlal Choudhary upheld core PMLA provisions — Sections 5, 8, 17, 19 and 24 — settling constitutional challenges.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: Reserve Bank–Integrated Ombudsman Scheme effective 12 November 2021 — 'one nation, one ombudsman' for banks, NBFCs and system participants.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: RBI launched the Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (12 Nov 2021), subsuming Banking/NBFC/Digital schemes; replaced by RB-IOS 2026 from 1 July 2026 (caps ₹30L/₹3L).

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: RBI dissolved the Banking Codes and Standards Board of India (registered 18 Feb 2006); role moved to its consumer-protection framework.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: RBI's Account Aggregator framework (2021) enabled consent-based financial data sharing through licensed NBFC-AAs — revocable, encrypted, purpose-limited consent.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: e-RUPI prepaid digital voucher launched on 2 August 2021 for purpose-specific cashless payments.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: e-RUPI, the person-and-purpose-specific digital voucher, was launched for leak-proof benefit transfers.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: RBI's Positive Pay System for cheques from 1 January 2021 — issuer shares details for cheques of Rs 50,000+, mandatory at Rs 5 lakh+.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: UK courts cleared the extradition of Nirav Modi to India in the PNB fraud case (~₹13,850 crore via fraudulent LoUs).

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: DICGC deposit-insurance cover enhanced to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: Union Budget 2020 raised DICGC deposit insurance from Rs 1 lakh to Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank (effective February 2020).

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: RBI permitted video-based customer identification (V-CIP) for full KYC onboarding.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: NEFT became operational 24x7; RTGS followed on 14 December 2020.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: India Post Payments Bank launched on 1 September 2018, leveraging the postal network for doorstep banking.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: RBI's April 2018 circular required all payment system data to be stored only in India — the landmark data-localisation rule every payments question traces back to.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: PNB disclosed the Nirav Modi LoU fraud (~₹13,850 crore); ED's subsequent attachments totalled about ₹2,324.97 crore — India's landmark trade-finance control failure.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: Finance Act, 2018: Companies Act Section 447 fraud became a PMLA scheduled offence; Section 45(1) bail twin-conditions revived after Nikesh Tarachand Shah (2017).

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: RBI's zero-liability circular: customers reporting unauthorised transactions within 3 working days face nil liability.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: RBI issued its Cyber Security Framework for banks on 2 June 2016 — board-approved standalone policy, baseline controls, 2–6 hour incident reporting. IIBF still lists it; study it historically and check current RBI directions.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: UPI launched by NPCI on 11 April 2016 — instant inter-bank transfers via VPA, QR and mobile number.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: NPCI launched UPI; IMPS had pioneered 24x7 instant transfers since 22 November 2010.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: RBI issued the Master Direction on KYC (DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16) — the framework that governed bank KYC until the 2025 Directions.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: Central KYC Records Registry (CKYCR) operationalised through CERSAI — one 14-digit KYC identifier reusable across the financial sector.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: RBI set up ReBIT (2016) as its dedicated cyber-security subsidiary and the CSITE examination cell (2015) — institutional muscle behind the cyber framework.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: RBI issued the Charter of Customer Rights, listing five customer rights including suitability and grievance redress.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: PMMY (MUDRA) launched on 8 April 2015 — collateral-free loans via Shishu, Kishor and Tarun categories.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Supreme Court struck down IT Act Section 66A in Shreya Singhal v. Union of India (2015) — vague restriction on free speech. Note: police still occasionally invoke it; a classic exam trap.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: PMJDY launched on 28 August 2014 — zero-balance accounts, RuPay cards, Rs 10,000 overdraft, Rs 2 lakh accident cover for newer accounts.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: The Gopalakrishna Working Group report (2011) on information security, electronic banking and technology risk management laid the foundation for RBI's 2016 Cyber Security Framework.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: NPCI incorporated in December 2008 — operates UPI, CTS, NACH, AePS, BBPS and RuPay.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: UCP 600 (ICC Publication 600, 39 articles) came into force for documentary credits worldwide.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: RBI permitted banks to engage Business Correspondents/Business Facilitators for branchless banking.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: PMLA, 2002 enforced from 1 July 2005 — banks must do KYC and report suspicious transactions to FIU-IND.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: PMLA and the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 came into force — CTR/STR reporting to FIU-IND began.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND) established under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: CERT-In became operational in January 2004 as India's nodal cyber-incident agency (IT Act Sec 70B). Its 2022 directions: report incidents within 6 hours, retain logs 180 days in India.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: SARFAESI Act, 2002 enacted (assented 17 Dec 2002; in force mid-2002) — secured creditors can enforce security without courts.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: The IT Act, 2000 came into force on 17 October 2000 (assent 9 June 2000); the 2008 amendment took effect 27 October 2009, adding 43A, 66A–66F and 69A/69B.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.body: FEMA came into force, replacing FERA 1973 and making violations civil offences with monetary penalties.

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: INFINET, IDRBT's closed secure network for banks and financial institutions, was set up in 1999 — the backbone over which SFMS carries NEFT/RTGS messages.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: Banking Ombudsman Scheme introduced in June 1995 under Section 35A of the BR Act — later merged into RB-IOS.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: Six more banks nationalised on 15 April 1980, taking the nationalised count to 20.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: 14 major banks with deposits over Rs 50 crore nationalised on 19 July 1969.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: State Bank of India constituted on 1 July 1955 under the SBI Act, 1955, succeeding the Imperial Bank of India.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: RBI nationalised on 1 January 1949, becoming fully state-owned.

capsules.subject: DBF
capsules.body: RBI established on 1 April 1935 under the RBI Act, 1934 — India's central bank and sole note-issuing authority.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: RBI issued the draft Reserve Bank of India (Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026, proposing a standard operating procedure for temporary debit holds on amounts or accounts linked to suspected money-mule activity and cyber-enabled fraud; public comments are invited until 2 October 2026 and the directions are proposed to commence on 1 April 2027.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: The draft KYC Amendment Directions, 2026 follow the Supreme Court's 4 August 2026 order (suo motu proceedings on digital-arrest scams) directing the RBI to prescribe an SOP; a money-mule account is defined as an account used 'knowingly or unknowingly' to move the proceeds of cyber fraud, with temporary debit holds proposed to be capped at 60 days.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: Under the draft money-mule SOP, when unusual transfers of Rs 1,000 or more are flagged, banks would freeze only the disputed transaction amount instead of the entire account; the customer gets 20 calendar days to establish legitimacy, the bank 10 days to assess, and unresolved cases go to the jurisdictional police through the NCRP/CFCFRMS portal, with law enforcement getting 30 days to issue a formal restraint order.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: RBI amended the KYC framework to extend the simplified KYC certification facility to Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) at urban and rural co-operative banks: certified copies of KYC documents may now be attested by an authorised official of an overseas branch of a scheduled commercial bank registered in India, a notary public abroad, or the Indian Embassy/Consulate — a facility earlier available to NRIs/PIOs; effective immediately under the PMLA, 2002.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.body: The Rajasthan High Court, in a single judgment, disposed of 105 writ petitions challenging blanket bank-account freezes in cyber-fraud cases — in some cases the disputed transaction was below Rs 100 or Rs 1,000 while the entire account stayed inoperative — underlining why the RBI's draft SOP caps such holds at 60 days and targets only the disputed amount.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: RBI granted recognition to the Unified Fintech Forum (UFF) as a Self-Regulatory Organisation for the FinTech sector (SRO-FT) — the second such recognition after the FinTech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE) in August 2024, aimed at strengthening self-regulation and responsible growth in the fintech ecosystem.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.body: IIBF opened registration for the CAIIB November-December 2026 cycle (13 September to 1 October 2026); papers are scheduled 6-27 December 2026 — Advanced Bank Management (6 Dec), Bank Financial Management (12 Dec), Advanced Business & Financial Management (13 Dec), Banking Regulations & Business Laws (20 Dec) and electives (27 Dec).

capsules.subject: Certified Information System Banker
capsules.body: Under the RBI's draft money-mule framework, banks would be required to use AI-based transaction monitoring systems to flag transfers that are sudden, disproportionate to the customer's declared profile, or linked to known cyber-fraud networks — a key technology control for fraud-risk management in banks.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: Supreme Court (CJI Surya Kant bench, 29 Sep) declined an interim stay on the Centre’s UPI MDR framework for specified person-to-merchant transactions above Rs 2,000, effective 15 Oct 2026 — 0.4% MDR capped at Rs 300; about 96% of merchant transactions stay at zero MDR and P2P transfers remain free.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: IIP grew 8% y/y in August 2026 (data released 28 Sep), beating the 6.5% Reuters poll estimate and accelerating from 7.4% in July — a strong read for credit demand in the festive quarter.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: FM Nirmala Sitharaman met AIIB President Zou Jiayi in Doha on 29 Sep on the sidelines of the 11th AIIB Annual Meeting (27–29 Sep) — India backed the bank’s 2027 budget plans and pushed for wider lending scope including AI-linked infrastructure.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: Rajya Sabha passed the Gig Workers Social Security and Welfare Bill, 2026 on 29 Sep (Lok Sabha cleared it 22 Sep); ESIC will implement it and platforms must contribute 2% of transaction value toward PF for an estimated 7.7 crore gig workers.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: Pashudhan Bima Portal launched 28 Sep in New Delhi — a single digital platform for livestock insurance (policy issuance to claim settlement) under the Livestock Insurance Scheme; watch for agri/rural portfolio implications.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: Labour Ministry’s ’Shram Samvad’ 90-day awareness campaign on the labour codes began 28 Sep across 316 districts; ILO-recognised social security coverage has risen to 101 crore people (68%) from 19% in 2015.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — The Sensex crashed 1,177 points to close at 71,461 and the Nifty fell 371 points to 22,231 (an 18-month low) on 8 Oct, wiping out ~₹10 lakh crore of investor wealth. Triggers: the RBI hiked the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50% (its first hike in nearly four years) and shifted its stance to ‘calibrated tightening’, Brent crude crossed $104/barrel, and FIIs sold ₹6,121 crore of equities.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — The Centre has decided to cap trade margins at 30% of MRP for all non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs — 110 drugs including 35 patented medicines — which could cut MRPs by up to 70% and save patients ~₹2,500 crore a year. The NPPA approved the move in principle at its 151st meeting on 8 Oct (chaired by Manoj Joshi); a 2019 pilot on 42 drugs cut prices up to 91%, saving ₹984 crore.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — The US Labour Department on 8 Oct suspended 8 tech majors — TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCLTech, Cognizant, Capgemini, Microsoft and Adobe — from the Permanent Labour Certification (PERM) programme, the key step in employment-based green cards, over alleged H-1B abuse. Labour Secretary Keith Sonderling said the firms had sought ‘almost three million foreign workers’ since 2009; VP JD Vance alleged Microsoft laid off 6,000 Americans in 2025 while securing 6,300 H-1B visas.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — Reliance Jio unveiled ‘Sovereign Satellite Connectivity’ at India Mobile Congress 2026 (10th edition, inaugurated by PM Modi on 8 Oct; theme ‘Scale Without Boundaries’): a proposed constellation of ~1,600 low-earth-orbit satellites with 23 ground stations in India, targeting 100% land-and-maritime coverage reaching 600,000+ villages, plus direct-to-device calling for rural areas.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — PM Narendra Modi on 8 Oct called for a global framework to tackle cross-border cyber fraud and the growing threat of deepfakes, urging governments, technology companies, telecom operators and financial institutions to build a mechanism that stops such frauds before they reach people.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 7 Oct 2026 — Amid soaring jet-fuel prices, the government is considering reviving a price stabilisation fund for aviation turbine fuel (ATF) and is in talks with airlines and oil marketing companies on high ATF costs.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 7 Oct 2026 — GST collections in the first half of FY27 rose 11.6%, driven by imports and manufacturing growth, with September collections strong.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 7 Oct 2026 — The World Bank projects South Asia's economy to grow 6.9% in 2026, while warning of energy and weather risks.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 7 Oct 2026 — Titan's consumer businesses grew 25% year-on-year in Q2 FY27, driven by strong growth in jewellery, watches and eyewear.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 7 Oct 2026 — India's electricity demand is set to rise 6.4% annually through 2030, adding 570 TWh of annual consumption as factories and data centres expand.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — Bank of Baroda (BoB) has become the second public sector bank in India to enter the pension fund business, receiving a Certificate of Appointment as Sponsor of a Pension Fund from the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA). The approval was granted under Section 27 of the PFRDA Act, 2013.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — Jio Platforms' IPO is set to open on 21 October 2026, with listing likely on 28 October — one of the year's biggest listings.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — The Ministry of Power notified the CAFE-3 fuel-efficiency norms on 30 September 2026, effective from April 2027 to 2032, with revised weight formulas and EV super credits.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — India's passenger vehicle sales surged 21.4% to 4.63 lakh units in September 2026, driven by GST 2.0 tax relief; the top four carmakers reported a 30.2% sales jump to 2.1 million units in H1 FY27.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics “for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin”, announced by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. IceCube is a cubic-kilometre neutrino detector frozen into the Antarctic ice at the South Pole; its optical sensors catch the faint flashes of rare high-energy neutrinos arriving from deep space. The chemistry prize follows on 7 Oct, literature on 8 Oct, peace on 9 Oct and economics on 12 Oct.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — IndiGo has raised fuel surcharges on domestic and international tickets after another hike in aviation turbine fuel (ATF) prices, adding to rising air-travel costs.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — Dulux paint maker AkzoNobel is nearing a deal to sell its Southeast Asian decorative-paints business to Japan's Nippon Paint for well over $1 billion, the Financial Times reported.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — Eurozone business activity expanded in September at its fastest pace in nearly three-and-a-half years, a private PMI survey showed, even as inflation worries linked to the Middle East war kept price pressures high.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — The GST Council meeting has been rescheduled to 8 October, as reported today.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 6 Oct 2026 — India and Switzerland on 5 Oct signed a migration and mobility partnership pact and agreed to expand Swiss market access for Indian exports, after talks between PM Narendra Modi and Swiss President Guy Parmelin in New Delhi. The two sides also agreed to deepen cooperation in nuclear energy, defence and critical technologies.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — The RBI's six-member Monetary Policy Committee began its three-day meeting today; the repo-rate decision is due on 7 October. Markets widely expect a 25 bps hike to 5.50% — which would be the first increase since February 2023, when the rate was raised to 6.50%. The repo rate has sat at 5.25% through four consecutive reviews after cumulative 125 bps cuts in 2025. Drivers: August CPI at 4.82% (third straight month above the 4% target), Brent crude near $101 a barrel, and the US Fed's recent hike. A 25 bps rise could push floating home-loan rates from 8.5% to 8.75%, adding about ₹795 a month to a ₹50 lakh, 20-year EMI.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — Delhi's air quality hit an 83-day high of 187 ('moderate') on 4 Oct and eased to 183 on 5 Oct, per the CPCB; the last higher reading was 246 on 13 July. Sixteen monitoring stations recorded 'poor' air (Mundka 273, Narela 257), and NCR cities Noida (281), Ghaziabad (248) and Faridabad (224) slipped into 'poor' too. If the AQI crosses 200, GRAP Stage 1 kicks in. CPCB bands: 0–50 good, 51–100 satisfactory, 101–200 moderate, 201–300 poor, 301–400 very poor, 401–500 severe. The IARI recorded 203 stubble-burning incidents across Punjab, UP and MP between 15 September and 3 October; Delhi saw its most polluted October start in four years.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — Karl Deisseroth (54, American), Peter Hegemann (71, German) and Georg Nagel (73, German) won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine “for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics”, announced by the Nobel Assembly at Sweden's Karolinska Institute. Optogenetics lets scientists switch individual nerve cells in a living brain on or off with light; the method is used in labs worldwide to reveal neural circuits behind memory, feelings and behaviour, and is being explored to restore sight. Hegemann and Nagel discovered the light-sensitive channelrhodopsin protein in the alga Chlamydomonas; Deisseroth (Stanford) showed in 2005 that it can control nerve cells. The 12-million-Swedish-crown prize (about $1.2 million) is shared; the physics, chemistry, literature, peace and economics prizes follow this week.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — India defended their Asian Games men's cricket gold on 3 Oct, beating Pakistan by 19 runs in the final at Nisshin (India 211/6, Pakistan 192/6). Abhishek Sharma's 61 off 28 and Tilak Varma's unbeaten 51 off 22 powered India; Hasan Nawaz's 51-ball 96 kept Pakistan in the hunt. Shreyas Iyer won the toss and chose to bat. It was the first India–Pakistan clash at the Asian Games, and the two sides avoided the customary handshakes. The gold completes a cricket double — India's women beat Sri Lanka in the final on 22 September — and Sri Lanka took bronze, beating Bangladesh by 63 runs.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — The Supreme Court (Justices B.V. Nagarathna and Augustine George Masih) has ruled that civil courts have no jurisdiction to entertain suits over SARFAESI recovery actions: challenges to measures under the SARFAESI Act, 2002 lie only before the Debts Recovery Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal. Section 34 of the Act expressly bars civil courts, Section 32 shields actions taken in good faith, and Section 35 gives the Act overriding effect over inconsistent laws.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — GST criminal prosecution may start only above Rs 5 crore, with routine tax-interpretation disputes likely kept out of courts under a GST Council shake-up — a step toward decriminalising minor tax offences.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — OPEC+ agreed on 4 Oct to keep oil production quotas steady for November; Brent crude closed Friday at $102.25 a barrel in New York, as the G7's release of 100 million barrels from strategic reserves (including diesel) counters record prices blamed on the Iran and Ukraine wars.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — The CBI has arrested a deputy director of the Directorate General of Civil Aviation in an alleged bribery case, officials said on 4 Oct.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 5 Oct 2026 — The Union Cabinet has approved a Rs 1,789.52-crore intelligent traffic management system for Delhi: 42 corridors, 1,092 adaptive signal points and 1,029 enforcement points, to be built in three phases over 24 months and operated for five years after that.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — The government raised the ceiling price of natural gas from deepwater, ultra-deepwater and HPHT fields to $9.89/MMBtu (from $8.90) for 1 Oct 2026–31 Mar 2027, per a PPAC notification — relief for producers like Reliance-BP's KG-D6. The ceiling for ONGC/OIL nomination fields stays at $7/MMBtu; the October APM price was notified at $11.22/MMBtu.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — The Cabinet fixed rabi MSP for 2026-27: mustard +₹413/quintal and lentil (masur) +₹390/quintal — the two biggest hikes — and wheat +₹25/quintal (<1%), signalling a push for oilseeds and pulses. IMD closed the 2026 monsoon at 759.4 mm — 87% of the long-period average — with 17 of 36 subdivisions deficient under a strong El Niño.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — India demonstrated its first 5.56-km free-space Quantum Key Distribution link — using quantum states of photons to share encryption keys with theoretically unbreakable security, a milestone for secure communication.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — Delhi launched an AI-powered Integrated Command and Control Centre to track pollution sources in real time ahead of winter smog — analysing air-quality data and flagging hotspots; over 700 construction sites are under AI/CCTV watch.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — An Indian parliamentary delegation led by Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh left for Tanzania for the 153rd Assembly of the Inter-Parliamentary Union (5–9 Oct). The IPU, founded in 1889 and headquartered in Geneva, is the global organisation of national parliaments.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — The RBI's six-member Monetary Policy Committee meets 5–7 October (decision on 7 Oct): 8 of 10 economists in a Business Standard poll expect the first rate hike since February 2023 — 25 basis points, taking the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50%. The RBI has held the repo unchanged for four straight reviews after cutting a cumulative 125 bps in 2025.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — BofA Securities' 'India Viewpoint' report expects the RBI to raise rates by a total of 100 basis points through the first half of 2027 (50 bps in Q4 FY27, 50 bps in H1 2027) — double its earlier 50-bp call. Barclays sees the terminal rate at 5.75%.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — SBI's Economic Research Department expects the RBI to raise its FY27 GDP forecast 30 bps (6.7% → 7.0%) and its inflation forecast 20 bps (5.0% → 5.2%) at the 5–7 Oct MPC. Group Chief Economic Advisor Soumya Kanti Ghosh notes inflation is becoming broad-based and the exchange rate needs 'protective guardrails'.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — CPI inflation rose to 4.82% in August 2026 (from 4.45% in July), above the RBI's 4% medium-term target for the third straight month, driven by energy and food costs; crude has stayed above $100 a barrel and the rupee is down ~6% this year.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 4 Oct 2026 — India finished 4th at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 with 85 medals: 21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze. China topped with 341 medals (169 gold), hosts Japan were second with 269 (83 gold), South Korea third with 150 (39 gold). India matched Uzbekistan on 21 golds but stayed ahead on silvers. The Games close today with the closing ceremony at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium (2:30–4 PM IST).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — The Union Cabinet (30 Sep) approved the Green Energy Corridor Phase-III: a ₹1,86,405-crore scheme (₹1,36,378 cr for intra-state transmission + ₹50,000 cr for 50 GWh of Battery Energy Storage) to evacuate up to 135 GW of renewable energy, with ₹54,082 crore of central support; completion targeted by FY 2032-33.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — The National Commission for Women submitted a 37-point report to the Centre (DoPT, Women & Child Development, Labour ministries): gender-neutral Child Care Leave for the private sector, mandatory paid paternity leave, and 5 lakh crèche seats by 2030 via a National Childcare Infrastructure Mission; the 730-day CCL would be split 365/365 between both working parents.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — The government revised sugar stock-holding rules: caps on the quantity dealers can hold and on the retention period, to discourage hoarding and speculative trading.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — The Commission for Air Quality Management reviewed NCR enforcement for 8–24 September: 197 inspections were reported across the National Capital Region (Environment Ministry).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — Bhubaneswar–Bangkok flights have resumed after a two-month suspension, restoring a direct air link between Odisha and Thailand.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — HDFC Bank, India's largest private lender, appointed Anup Bagchi as its next CEO for three years.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — September gross GST collections hit ₹2.04 lakh crore, up 14.7% year-on-year, on steady economic activity and pre-festive inventory build-up.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — The rupee breached 96 per dollar, touching 96.3150 — a two-month low — as surging US Treasury yields and FPI outflows pressured emerging-market currencies; Morgan Stanley sees 97 by December 2026.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — The RBI's MPC meets 5–7 Oct; SBI's Economic Research Department expects the hike cycle to begin with 25 bps (repo 5.50%), and FY27 forecasts upgraded to 7.0% GDP and 5.2% inflation.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 3 Oct 2026 — Q1 FY27 FDI equity inflows rose 6% YoY to $19.8 billion, led by Japan, even as inflows from the US contracted.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — SBI's Economic Research Department expects the RBI's MPC (5–7 Oct) to begin the rate-hike cycle with a 25 bps repo hike to 5.50%, and to upgrade the FY27 GDP growth forecast from 6.7% to 7.0% and inflation from 5.0% to 5.2%.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — Morgan Stanley expects India's FY27 GDP growth at 7.3% and the rupee at 97 per dollar by December 2026 (98.5 by Dec 2027); it sees the coming rate hikes as policy normalisation, with the real policy rate averaging 1.2% in 2027 vs 0.7% in 2026.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — On 28 September 2026 the Supreme Court declined to stay the 0.4% UPI merchant fee (above ₹2,000) starting 15 October 2026; a CJI Surya Kant-led bench issued notice to the Centre, RBI and NPCI, giving four weeks to explain the charge's basis (Anjan Datta v. Union of India).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — The Supreme Court (Justices P.S. Narasimha and Alok Aradhe, judgment 30 Sep 2026) ruled the NCLT can recall admission of a corporate insolvency resolution process if founded on fraud and collusion — jurisdictional facts are conditions precedent; it may also proceed under Section 65 of the IBC.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — UPI processed 24.07 billion transactions worth ₹29.37 lakh crore in September 2026 (NPCI): down 1.8% month-on-month but up 23% year-on-year in volume and 18% in value, averaging 802 million transactions a day.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 1 Oct 2026 — Apple Pay launched in India with initial Axis Bank Visa/Mastercard support — watch digital-payments and card-network questions.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 1 Oct 2026 — Mumbai property registrations hit 12,622 in September 2026 (+5% YoY), the highest September total in 14+ years (Knight Frank India) — housing-finance demand signal.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 1 Oct 2026 — FASTag Annual Pass issuances crossed one crore since the August 2025 launch (₹3,075; one-year validity or 200 toll crossings at ~1,150 plazas).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 1 Oct 2026 — UIDAI launched five Aadhaar Day initiatives at Aadhaar Samvaad Kolkata, including Face Authentication for ePDS and SWIK Portal 2.0.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 1 Oct 2026 — ₹1,600 crore approved for 41 Pharma/MedTech innovation projects under the first PRIP round.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 1 Oct 2026 — The Defence Accounts Department marked its 279th Annual Day and launched digital initiatives.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: Bank of America Securities (30 Sep 2026) brought forward its first RBI hike call to October and raised its total hike forecast to 100 bps through H1 2027, taking the terminal repo rate to 6.25%; stance expected to switch to 'calibrated tightening' in December.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: SEBI's board (30 Sep 2026) cleared a sweeping overhaul of portfolio management and settlement rules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: Sagarmala Finance Corporation launched India's first Blue Bond on 28 September 2026: Rs 600 crore with a Rs 500 crore green-shoe option, 10-year tenor, AA+ rated by ICRA and CARE, arranged by SBI Capital Markets.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: IndusInd Bank launched a dedicated GCC Banking vertical integrating digital banking, employee banking, commercial cards, FEMA/capital-account solutions and foreign-currency accounts via its GIFT City IBU.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: The rupee weakened to 96.14 per US dollar on 30 September 2026 as FPIs offloaded Rs 9,200 crore of FAR bonds in September, snapping a five-month buying spree.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: The Union Cabinet (1 Oct 2026) approved the Rs 1.86 lakh crore PM-DHARA scheme for intra-state power transmission networks with battery storage, targeting 135 GW of renewable energy transfer — a mega infra-capex signal for bank credit growth.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: The Centre raised the wheat MSP by Rs 25 to Rs 2,610 per quintal for 2027-28; pulses and oilseeds received hikes of up to Rs 675 per quintal — relevant for agri lending and food-credit policy.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: The RBI's MPC meets 5–7 October 2026 with the repo rate at 5.25%; the August IIP print (8%, manufacturing up 9%) feeds into the growth-inflation assessment.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: Foreign investors withdrew $2.7 billion from Indian equities in September 2026 amid global rate concerns, pressuring the rupee and domestic liquidity.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: The government cut the windfall tax on diesel and ATF exports; Apple launched its flagship payment services in India, entering the UPI-dominated payments market.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — RBI MPC (5–7 October 2026): Reuters poll of 61 economists — 35 expect a 25 bps repo hike to 5.50% (first since Feb 2023); repo currently 5.25%; August CPI 4.82%, third straight month above the 4% medium-term target.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — BofA Securities now expects 100 bps of RBI hikes through H1 2027 (up from 50 bps earlier), starting October, terminal repo 6.25%; it expects the stance to change to 'calibrated tightening' in December.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — Nomura: 25 bps hikes in October and December to a 5.75% terminal rate; sees CPI at 6.3% in Q4 2026; forecasts FY27 CPI 5.2%, FY28 4%; food inflation the biggest near-term risk on deficient monsoons and poor kharif sowing.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — Banking data points: non-food credit growth 17.8% y/y in September 2026; bank credit grew over 19% in July; tradables inflation 5.9% in August; the rupee weakened about 6% in 2026.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — The CAIIB ABM paper (6 Dec 2026) covers monetary policy transmission: note the RBI's likely pivot from pause to calibrated tightening — frame the 'monetary policy' module around this live example.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 2 Oct 2026 — Concept anchor: a repo-rate hike raises banks' cost of funds — MCLR and EBLR-linked loans reprice upward. Revise the 'pricing of bank products' and 'interest rate risk' units around this live example.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 8 Oct 2026 — RBI's MPC raised the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50% (5–7 Oct meeting), shifting the stance to 'Calibrated Tightening'; SDF 5.25%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%. Revise the monetary-policy transmission unit around this live example.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 8 Oct 2026 — Bank of Baroda became the second PSB to enter the pension fund business after PFRDA's Certificate of Appointment as Sponsor under Section 27 of the PFRDA Act, 2013 (SBI was first, April 2008).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 8 Oct 2026 — The World Bank raised India's FY27 growth forecast to 7.1% from 6.6%, citing 7.8% Q1 FY27 growth — context for the economic-environment sections.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 8 Oct 2026 — India's defence exports in FY 2025–26 crossed ₹38,000 crore; the DRDO-developed Akash system added Turkmenistan (and Tajikistan) as export destinations.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 8 Oct 2026 — The DoT's Chakshu portal for reporting suspected fraud communications crossed 30 crore visits — a live case study for the fraud-risk and customer-protection units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — SME Growth Fund (6 Oct 2026 Cabinet): Rs 10,000-crore AIF commitment for growth-stage SMEs; Budget 2026-27 announcement. Exam anchor: contrast growth equity with bank credit in the MSME-lending and priority-sector modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — 57th GST Council (8 Oct 2026): GST officers' arrest powers proposed for removal; prosecution threshold Rs 1 cr to Rs 5 cr; minimum punishment removed; general penalty Rs 25,000 to Rs 10,000; automated refunds. JAIIB/CAIIB indirect-tax and compliance-risk angles.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — GST H1 FY27 data: gross Rs 12.46 lakh cr (+11.6% y/y); taxable supplies +25.8% (Oct 2025–Jul 2026) after 22 Sep 2025 rationalisation; net collections +10.4%; refunds about Rs 1.80 lakh cr. Use for data-interpretation practice.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — ITLA: Cabinet approves the Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority SPV — apex body for integrated transport planning. Anchor for infrastructure-finance and project-appraisal units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 9 Oct 2026 — JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) launch (8 Oct 2026) under TB Mukt Bharat: 55 districts in 11 states; five NCC cadets + five MY Bharat volunteers per team; TB incidence down 21% (global 12%), treatment coverage 92% (global 78%).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — Bihar's MSME Policy 2026 will develop 45,000 entrepreneurs with Rs 3,500 crore — 14,000 SC/ST, 10,000 EBC, 9,500 women, 9,000 youth, 2,500 minority — targeting 1 crore families self-reliant through entrepreneurship.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — Under the MSME Policy 2026, 25–40% of Bihar government procurement will come from in-state products; the state targets Rs 5 lakh crore in industrial investment via PPP and 20,000 MW of power to industry in five years.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — The Centre allocated Rs 10,000 crore for the MSME sector, of which Bihar expects at least one-tenth (~Rs 1,000 crore); CM Samrat Choudhary also announced ropeways at 20 locations in two years and 100% solar power for all agricultural feeders within a year.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — The Chemistry Nobel (8 Oct) matters for banking-adjacent pharma credit: single-enantiomer drug design — Kagan and Soai's asymmetric synthesis — underpins how modern pharmaceutical manufacturing (and its project finance) works.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — The 57th GST Council (8 Oct 2026) scrapped arrest powers under GST and raised the prosecution threshold from Rs 1 crore to Rs 5 crore.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — The general penalty under GST was cut from Rs 25,000 to Rs 10,000; refund-claim acknowledgement cut from 15 to 10 days.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — GST rate changes will now be decided once a year; faceless tax administration under CGST is planned for FY28.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — 1.70 crore GST taxpayers (Sept 2026); gross collections Rs 12.46 lakh crore in Apr–Sep 2026 (+11.6% YoY); reforms effective 1 April 2027.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — The RBI opened a special dollar window for Indian Oil, HPCL and BPCL (from 12 Oct 2026), letting the three state oil marketers buy dollars directly from its forex reserves to ease spot-market pressure on the rupee.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — The RBI cut the exchange-traded rupee currency-derivative position limit from $100 million to $5 million, barred rebooking of rupee FX derivatives, and ordered a 20% foreign exchange risk reserve on each rupee derivative contract's notional.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — The RBI raised minimum daily CRR maintenance from 90% to 99% of the prescribed requirement (effective fortnight beginning 16 Oct 2026) and announced a Rs 25,000-crore OMO sale of government securities on 13 October 2026.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 10 Oct 2026 — The RBI's October MPC raised the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50% (first hike since 2023), shifted the stance to 'calibrated tightening', and raised the FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1% from 6.7%.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — From 15 Oct 2026, specified UPI merchant payments above ₹2,000 carry 0.4% MDR (capped at ₹300); P2P transfers stay free. Anchor for payments-systems and fee-income units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses: ₹11,440 crore outlay over 2025-26 to 2030-31; assured procurement of Tur, Urad and Masoor by NAFED/NCCF under PM-AASHA. Anchor for priority-sector/agri-credit units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — The 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave concluded in New Delhi on the theme ‘Resilience in an Era of Transformation’. Anchor for economy modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — India’s textile and apparel economy is set to grow from $196 billion to $350 billion, powered by the ₹8,100 crore PLI scheme and the National Technical Textiles Mission.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — PM Modi launches Chennai projects worth over ₹13,000 crore on 11 Oct; Chennai Metro Phase II Poonamallee–Vadapalani (~₹4,900 crore) includes a 3.7-km double-decker structure. Anchor for infra-finance units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 11 Oct 2026 — The Indian Navy will induct the indigenous anti-submarine warfare vessel ‘Mangrole’ (PIB, 10 Oct 2026).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — RBI's MPC hiked the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026 (first hike since Feb 2023); stance 'calibrated tightening'; FY27 GDP 7.1%, CPI 5.2%. Anchor for treasury/ALM units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — Anup Bagchi takes charge as HDFC Bank MD & CEO from 27 Oct 2026 — the bank's first external appointee. Anchor for governance modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — Lavanya R Mundayur appointed CMD of New India Assurance (order 30 Sep 2026; tenure till 31 May 2029); earlier CMD of AICIL. Anchor for insurance modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — Bank of India launched programmable Digital Rupee auto-issuance (29 Sep 2026; Montran India): scheduled, purpose-bound CBDC transfers. Anchor for payments-systems units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — The World Bank raised India's FY27 GDP forecast to 7.1% (from 6.6%); Q1 FY27 grew 7.8%. Anchor for economy modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — Diesel export levy cut ₹20→₹16/L and ATF ₹15→₹10.50/L from 1 Oct 2026; petrol unchanged at ₹0.50/L. Anchor for trade-finance units.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — The 2026 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences went to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford (announced 12 Oct 2026). Anchor for economy modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize went to South African jurist Navanethem ‘Navi’ Pillay (announced 9 Oct 2026 in Oslo) for her efforts to promote peace and international law. Anchor for current-awareness modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — The 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature went to Canadian author Anne Carson (announced 8 Oct 2026). Anchor for current-awareness modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry went to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai (announced 7 Oct 2026) for non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. Anchor for current-awareness modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 31 Oct 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh. Anchor for leadership modules.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.body: 12 Oct 2026 — The 3rd Sagarmanthan oceans dialogue was held 7–9 Oct 2026 in New Delhi on ‘Blue Geographies, New Aspirations: Trade, Technology, and Trust at Sea’. Anchor for blue-economy modules.

capsules.subject: RBI Policy
capsules.title: LAF corridor after 7 Oct 2026 — certification-ready summary
capsules.body: Policy rates from 7 October 2026: repo 5.50% | SDF 5.25% | MSF 5.75% | Bank Rate 5.75% | stance: calibrated tightening. Certification angle (JAIIB/CAIIB): the LAF corridor is 25 bps on either side of the repo (SDF = floor, MSF = ceiling); the Bank Rate tracks the MSF; ‘calibrated tightening’ means the next move is a hike or a pause — the easing bias of 2025 (125 bps of cuts, 6.50%→5.25%) stands reversed. Remember the circular number RBI/2026-27/282 (FMOD.MAOG.No.154/01.01.001/2026-27) dated 7 October 2026.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: Why the RBI hiked in October 2026 — the macro rationale (7 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The RBI’s October 2026 policy blamed inflation risks on the September re-escalation of the West Asia conflict, hardening crude (~USD 100/barrel), deficient monsoon, and food/fuel/fertiliser pressures — pushing projected CPI to 5.2% for FY27 with a Q3 peak near 5.9%. Globally, the US Federal Reserve had raised its policy rate by 25 bps in September 2026 and US 10-year yields hovered around 5.3%, tightening global financial conditions. For exams: this is the textbook case of imported inflation + supply shock forcing a central bank into a hike cycle despite 7.8% Q1 growth.

capsules.subject: RBI
capsules.title: RBI tightens forex derivative norms (12 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The RBI's 12 October 2026 circular revised the Master Direction on Risk Management and Inter-Bank Dealings: (i) INR non-deliverable derivative contracts for non-residents are now hedging-only; (ii) a 20% FX risk reserve applies to certain authorised-dealer transactions; (iii) rules on rebooking cancelled derivative contracts were tightened. The changes apply prospectively.

capsules.subject: RBI Policy
capsules.title: LAF corridor after the October 2026 hike: SDF 5.25%, repo 5.50%, MSF 5.75%
capsules.body: After the 7 October 2026 hike, the Liquidity Adjustment Facility corridor is: SDF 5.25% (floor), repo 5.50% (policy rate), MSF 5.75% (ceiling). The Bank Rate — the rate at which the RBI buys or rediscounts bills of exchange — is also 5.75%.

capsules.subject: RBI Policy
capsules.title: What ‘calibrated tightening’ means for banks
capsules.body: In October 2026 the MPC moved from a neutral stance to calibrated tightening (4–2 vote). For bankers it signals that the policy rate path ahead is a hike or a pause — rate cuts are off the table in the near term — so floating-rate loan EMIs linked to external benchmarks will rise while deposit-rate hikes may lag because of surplus system liquidity.

capsules.subject: Financial Inclusion
capsules.title: NBFC-Account Aggregator interoperability announced
capsules.body: The RBI’s October 2026 policy announced interoperability among NBFC-Account Aggregators: customers can access and share their financial information across financial service providers through any account aggregator of their choice, strengthening consent-based data sharing under the AA framework.

capsules.subject: Capital Markets
capsules.title: Demat CAS to include bank deposit account information
capsules.body: The RBI announced it will facilitate SEBI-regulated depositories to include information related to deposit accounts in the consolidated account statement (CAS), so demat holders can view holdings and bank deposits in one place.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: CAIIB May/June 2026 result declared (11 Sep 2026)
capsules.body: IIBF declared the CAIIB / CAIIB Elective May-June 2026 result on 11 September 2026. Candidates can download the scorecard from the IIBF Digital Candidate Portal by signing in with their registered email ID, mobile number or membership number (with OTP verification).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: JAIIB November 2026 exam schedule
capsules.body: JAIIB November 2026 registrations were open 1-21 August 2026. The paper-wise exams fall on 1 November (IE and IFS), 22 November (PPB), 28 November (AFM) and 29 November 2026 (RBWM) - aspirants should be in final revision now (15 Oct 2026).

capsules.subject: Banking Sector
capsules.title: October 2026 policy scorecard: repo 5.50%, FY27 GDP 7.1%, CPI 5.2%, next MPC 2–4 Dec (7 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The MPC voted unanimously to hike the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50% and 4–2 to shift stance to 'calibrated tightening'. Projections: real GDP growth 7.1% and CPI inflation 5.2% for FY27. The next MPC meeting is scheduled for 2–4 December 2026. (Dated: 7 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: October 2026 rate hike: key numbers
capsules.body: Repo 5.50%, SDF 5.25%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%, CRR 3.00%, SLR 18.00%; stance 'calibrated tightening'; FY27 GDP growth 7.1% and CPI inflation 5.2% projected. First hike since February 2023. Memorise the corridor: SDF = repo - 25 bps, MSF/Bank Rate = repo + 25 bps.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: Yes Bank AT-1 bonds: SC judgment 15 Oct 2026
capsules.body: Yes Bank Ltd. & Anr. v. Axis Trustee Services Ltd. & Ors. (2026 INSC 1132), decided 15 October 2026 by Justices Dipankar Datta and Augustine George Masih: appeals dismissed; Bombay High Court's setting aside of the Rs. 8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-down stands. The case is a landmark on the limits of administrative authority in bank reconstruction under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.

capsules.subject: RBI & Regulation
capsules.title: Banking supervision leadership change at RBI — Verified: 17 Oct 2026
capsules.body: Shri Sudhakar Malli took charge as RBI Executive Director on 1 October 2026 and heads the Department of Supervision (Supervisory Assessment), overseeing supervision of banks, NBFCs and co-operative banks. He holds a B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering and is a Certified Associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers (CAIIB).

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: JAIIB Nov 2026 papers on 1, 22, 28 & 29 November
capsules.body: The Indian Institute of Banking & Finance (IIBF) declared the JAIIB May 2026 cycle result on 4 August 2026 (exams held 3, 9, 10 and 17 May). Candidates needing a re-attempt can sit the November 2026 cycle on 1, 22, 28 and 29 November 2026. Qualifying marks are 50 out of 100; IIBF issues a digitally signed e-certificate (downloadable up to 3 times) within about 60 days of the result.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: CAIIB May/June 2026 result declared on 11 September
capsules.body: IIBF released the CAIIB May/June 2026 result on 11 September 2026 at iibf.org.in (examinations held 31 May–21 June 2026, including electives). Pass criterion: 50 marks in each paper, or 45 per subject with 50% overall in a single attempt. Candidates have 5 attempts or 3 years; the certification is valid for life, IIBF issues only digital certificates, and answer sheets are not re-evaluated.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: JAIIB November 2026: paper-wise dates and pattern
capsules.body: IIBF's JAIIB November 2026 cycle: Indian Economy & Indian Financial System — 1 November, Principles & Practices of Banking — 22 November, Accounting & Financial Management for Bankers — 28 November, Retail Banking & Wealth Management — 29 November 2026. Each paper: 100 MCQs, 2 hours, 100 marks, no negative marking; qualifying mark 50/100. The exam runs twice a year (May and November).

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: CAIIB December 2026: five papers, dates announced
capsules.body: CAIIB December 2026 cycle: Advanced Bank Management — 6 December, Bank Financial Management — 12 December, Advanced Business & Financial Management — 13 December, Banking Regulations & Business Laws — 20 December, elective papers — 27 December 2026. Four compulsory papers plus one elective (Rural Banking, HRM, IT & Digital Banking, Risk Management, Central Banking); passing JAIIB is the prerequisite.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: October 2026 MPC: must-know for IE&IFS
capsules.body: For the IE&IFS paper, note the RBI's 7 October 2026 decisions: repo 5.50% (+25 bps, first hike since February 2023), stance 'calibrated tightening', SDF 5.25%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.75%, FY27 GDP 7.1%, FY27 CPI 5.2%.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: Yes Bank AT-1 case: relevance for BRBL and BFM
capsules.body: The Supreme Court's 15 October 2026 judgment (2026 INSC 1132) setting aside the Rs 8,415 crore AT-1 write-down is directly relevant to BRBL (RBI's Basel III Master Circular, Administrator's powers under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949) and BFM (AT-1 as Additional Tier 1 capital).

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: 'Calibrated tightening': reading the stance for BFM
capsules.body: The October 2026 shift to 'calibrated tightening' takes rate cuts off the table — the next move is a hike or a pause. For BFM: expect upward pressure on banks' cost of funds, bond yields and NIMs, and mark-to-market pressure on investment books if the cycle extends.

capsules.subject: Financial Inclusion
capsules.title: Financial inclusion saturation drive, Oct-Dec 2026
capsules.body: The Finance Ministry's nationwide saturation campaign (21 October to 31 December 2026) targets 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies. Banks will run enrolment camps covering the three Jan Suraksha social-security schemes - PMJJBY (life insurance), PMSBY (accident insurance) and APY (pension) - plus Aadhaar seeding and nomination updates in savings accounts. - Verified: 20 Oct 2026

capsules.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
capsules.title: RBI MPC Oct 2026: repo to 5.50%; stance 'calibrated tightening'
capsules.body: The RBI's MPC (5-7 Oct 2026, Governor Sanjay Malhotra) raised the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50% — the first hike since February 2023 — and moved the stance from 'neutral' to 'calibrated tightening'. SDF: 5.25%; MSF and Bank Rate: 5.75%. Drivers: August CPI inflation 4.82%, crude above $100/barrel, FY27 inflation forecast raised to 5.2%, Q1 FY27 real GDP growth 7.8%. Signal: rate cuts are off the table near-term — future action is either another hike or a pause.

capsules.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
capsules.title: Minimum daily CRR maintenance raised to 99% (w.e.f. 16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The RBI raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance to 99% (from 90%) for scheduled banks, effective the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026 (notification of 9 Oct 2026 under Section 42(1), RBI Act, 1934). The prescribed CRR rate remains 3%; average compliance over the fortnight continues. Objective: manage surplus liquidity (~Rs 4 lakh crore) as policy shifts to calibrated tightening; banks lose the operational flexibility of running at 90% on individual days.

capsules.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
capsules.title: FEMA Export-Import Regulations 2026 effective 1 Oct 2026
capsules.body: The RBI notified the FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026, effective 1 October 2026: AD banks to upload export/import data in EDPMS/IDPMS within 5 working days for non-EDI ports; realisation/repatriation of export proceeds within 15 months (18 months for exports invoiced/settled in Indian rupees); self-declaration permitted for closure of export-monitoring entries up to Rs 10 lakh.

capsules.subject: Banking & Financial Awareness
capsules.title: UCB unsecured-advances ceiling: 10% to 20% proposal; Mission-SAKSHAM
capsules.body: The RBI proposed raising the aggregate ceiling on unsecured advances for UCBs from 10% to 20% of total assets (from 1 Oct 2026): unsecured advances beyond the ceiling allowed only for priority-sector loans up to Rs 50,000 per borrower; nominal-member consumer-durable lending capped at Rs 2.5 lakh per borrower; maximum unsecured loan limits of Rs 5 lakh / Rs 7.5 lakh / Rs 10 lakh for Tier-1 / Tier-2 / Tier-3&4 UCBs respectively; housing-loan tenor and moratorium deregulated for Tier-3/4 UCBs. The RBI also launched Mission-SAKSHAM to train 1.4 lakh+ UCB staff in governance, technology and risk management.

capsules.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
capsules.title: October 2026 policy: repo 5.50%, SDF 5.25%, MSF 5.75%, calibrated tightening
capsules.body:
JAIIB/CAIIB focus — October 2026 policy: repo 5.50% (+25 bps), SDF 5.25%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.75%, stance “calibrated tightening” (4–2). Governor Sanjay Malhotra; 63rd MPC meeting 5–7 Oct; minutes 21 Oct; next review 2–4 Dec 2026. First hike since Feb 2023.

Remember the corridor: SDF = repo − 25 bps; MSF = repo + 25 bps. 37% of CPI-basket items had inflation above 4% in August vs 20% in March — the generalisation of inflation that forced the hike.

capsules.subject: RBI & Monetary Policy
capsules.title: SDF vs MSF: floor and ceiling of the LAF corridor
capsules.body: Concept refresher: The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) lets banks park surplus liquidity with the RBI without collateral (introduced April 2022, replacing fixed-rate reverse repo as the floor of the LAF corridor). At 5.25% (Oct 2026) it anchors overnight rates from below; the MSF (5.75%) is the ceiling — banks can borrow overnight against SLR securities up to a limit.

capsules.subject: Banking Regulation
capsules.title: DICGC cover: ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank (premium 12 paise/₹100)
capsules.body:
Deposit insurance: The DICGC insures bank deposits — including in co-operative banks — up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor per bank (principal + interest combined). Premium is paid by banks, currently 12 paise per ₹100 of assessable deposits per half-year.

Exam tip: the ₹5-lakh cover applies per depositor per bank (same-bank branches aggregated; different banks counted separately).

capsules.subject: Banking
capsules.title: Liquidity tightening: CRR and OMO moves
capsules.body: The RBI raised minimum daily CRR maintenance from 90% to 99% effective 16 October 2026 (last done in July 2013) and conducted a ₹25,000-crore OMO bond sale on 13 October — both aimed at pulling the weighted average call rate closer to the 5.50% repo rate.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: Monetary transmission: 125 bps cut -> 93 bps fall in fresh-loan rates (RBI Bulletin, Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The RBI's October Bulletin study on transmission: in response to the cumulative 125 bps repo-rate cut between February 2025 and March 2026, the weighted average lending rate on fresh loans fell 93 bps — an 80 bps interest-rate effect plus a 13 bps composition effect. Lesson: overall lending-rate changes reflect repricing and shifts in the composition of lending — a favourite JAIIB/CAIIB exam angle on transmission.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: IBC: SC on default vs debt quantum (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Supreme Court ruled that profitability (EBITDA) is no ground to stall admission into CIRP: what must be proved is the occurrence of default — a static historical event — not the precise quantum of debt, provided the Section 4 threshold is met. A record of default from an information utility ranks highest in the evidentiary hierarchy and creates a presumption displaceable only by clear, cogent and compelling material. (Appeals: Deepak Raheja and another, re GSTAAD Hotels and Neo Capricorn Plaza.)

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: LAF corridor after 7 Oct 2026: SDF 5.25% floor, MSF 5.75% ceiling
capsules.body: Post-policy: repo 5.50%, SDF 5.25% (floor), MSF and Bank Rate 5.75% (ceiling), CRR 3% (unchanged). The stance is now 'calibrated tightening' (4-2 vote). MPC minutes of the 5-7 Oct meeting were released on 21 Oct 2026, signalling rate cuts are off the table with headline inflation projected to touch 6% in Q3 — the upper limit of the tolerance band.

capsules.subject: AML / KYC
capsules.title: TRAI 1600-series for genuine bank calls (20 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: TRAI now allows banks to use 1600-series numbers for two-way communication, helping customers identify genuine banking calls — a direct anti-fraud/KYC-hygiene measure. For AML/KYC papers: social-engineering and vishing remain major fraud vectors; verified caller identification complements transaction monitoring and customer awareness.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: NBFC-Account Aggregator interoperability (RBI, 7 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The RBI will facilitate interoperability among NBFC-Account Aggregators, so customers can access and share financial information across financial service providers through any account aggregator of choice. The account-aggregator framework (RBI's 2016 NBFC-AA licence class) is India's consent-based data-sharing layer — now maturing into full portability.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: IDBI Bank strategic sale to Fairfax (October 2026)
capsules.body: On 14 October 2026 the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax for Rs 52,878.08 crore. The deal was reported as set to become the largest foreign direct investment in India's financial sector. For banking-exam answers, note the distinction: this is a strategic disinvestment of a public-sector-linked bank stake, not a merger, and completion remains subject to regulatory steps.

capsules.subject: Risk Management
capsules.title: Why 'calibrated tightening' matters for bankers
capsules.body: In October 2026 the RBI moved from a neutral stance to 'calibrated tightening' while raising the repo rate to 5.50%. For certification exams, the transmission chain is: repo rate up → external-benchmark-linked lending rates reset higher → EMIs or tenures adjust → deposit rates may firm up. The stance wording itself signals that further hikes are possible but will be data-dependent.

capsules.subject: Banking Awareness
capsules.title: RBI October 2026 policy: first hike since February 2023
capsules.body: On 7 October 2026 the RBI MPC unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%, the first increase since February 2023, and moved the stance from neutral to calibrated tightening. The RBI raised its FY27 inflation forecast to 5.2% and its growth forecast to 7.1%, citing higher crude oil prices, rupee pressure and retail inflation of 4.82% in August 2026. Verified: 25 October 2026.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: Why the RBI cares about the WACR: the October 2026 example
capsules.body: The weighted average call rate (WACR) is the RBI's operating target: it is the rate at which banks lend to each other overnight. When surplus liquidity pushed the WACR well below the repo rate in October 2026, the RBI tightened conditions — a higher daily CRR floor and an open market sale — precisely to drag the WACR back up towards the 5.50 per cent repo rate.

capsules.subject: Current affairs
capsules.title: CA Intermediate September 2026 results (22 October 2026)
capsules.body: ICAI declared the CA Intermediate September 2026 results on 22 October 2026 at caresults.icai.org. Joint AIR 1: Neel Rajesh Shah (Mumbai) and Chandak Sakshi (Nashik), 502/600 (83.67%). Group I: 23,210 of 1,00,301 passed (23.14%); Group II: 12,938 of 68,400 passed (18.92%); both groups: 5,066 of 38,339 passed (13.21%). The September examinations were held on 1, 3, 6, 8, 10 and 12 September 2026.

capsules.subject: Markets
capsules.title: Government switch auction of 19 October 2026: smoothing the redemption profile (27 October 2026)
capsules.body: In a switch auction on 19 October 2026 for ₹20,000 crore, investors exchanged short-dated securities maturing in 2027-2029 for longer-dated ones such as the 7.41% GS 2036, 7.23% GS 2039 and 7.19% GS 2060; ₹3,000 crore of the 7.17% GS 2028 moved into the 7.41% GS 2036 at a cut-off yield of 7.3867%. Switch operations smooth the redemption profile and reduce rollover risk.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: Reading the MPC minutes: hike unanimous, stance divided
capsules.body: The minutes of the 5-7 October 2026 MPC meeting show all members backed the 25-basis-point hike to 5.50%. On the stance, four members voted for 'calibrated tightening' while Nagesh Kumar and Ram Singh preferred 'neutral' — a reminder that the stance vote and the rate vote are separate decisions.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: Forex reserves and credit growth (October 2026 snapshot)
capsules.body: India's foreign exchange reserves stood at USD 726.03 billion as on 9 October 2026, down USD 8.58 billion on the week. Bank credit grew 19.4% year-on-year and deposits 17.8% as on 30 September 2026 (RBI data, 16 October 2026).

capsules.subject: Banking Awareness
capsules.title: Currency in circulation: the 27 October 2026 fact-check
capsules.body: PIB Fact Check confirmed on 27 October 2026 that the RBI had made no announcement about a new Rs 1,000 note, debunking viral yellow-note images on Instagram, X and Telegram. For banking examinations, remember the active Mahatma Gandhi (New) Series denominations: Rs 10, Rs 20, Rs 50, Rs 100, Rs 200 and Rs 500.

capsules.subject: Risk Management
capsules.title: AI agents in banking: control, audit and accountability
capsules.body: Ahead of India's AI regulation consultation paper, experts have called for human control over AI agents, audit trails, incident reporting and clear accountability, particularly in banking. The consultation paper, announced by IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, will also cover deepfakes and the effect of AI on education.

capsules.subject: Banking Awareness
capsules.title: Trade-margin cap on cancer drugs: 30% of MRP
capsules.body: The Centre told the Supreme Court on 27 October 2026 that the trade margin on cancer drugs was capped at 30% of MRP. The hearing, in a PIL seeking price caps, highlighted a chemotherapy injection billed at Rs 1,30,000 against a dealer price of Rs 11,000, and noted that about 90% of medicines remain outside the Drug Price Control Order.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: RBI liquidity management, October 2026
capsules.body: After raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% on 7 October 2026, the RBI tightened daily liquidity management: minimum daily CRR maintenance rose from 90% to 99% from 16 October, and a Rs 25,000 crore open market operation sale of government securities was announced for 13 October. By late October the surplus had fallen to about Rs 50,000 crore on GST outflows, prompting variable-rate repo operations, including a seven-day operation of Rs 1 lakh crore. The weighted average call rate is the operating target of monetary policy.

capsules.subject: Other Banking Certifications
capsules.title: Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme and trade finance
capsules.body: Approved by the Cabinet on 28 October 2026 with an outlay of Rs 10,000 crore up to FY40, the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme aims to cut dependence on imported containers. Greenfield projects must have at least 1,00,000 TEU annual capacity and brownfield projects must add at least 25,000 TEU, with facilities commissioned within three years of in-principle approval and compliant with global container standards.

capsules.subject: JAIIB
capsules.title: CRR: rate, daily floor and average — do not confuse them
capsules.body: October 2026 — CRR rate: 3% of NDTL, no interest. Daily floor: 99% of the requirement (was 90%) from 16 October 2026. Fortnightly average: must still be at least the full prescribed requirement. The change tightens timing flexibility, it does not raise the CRR rate.

capsules.subject: CAIIB
capsules.title: Liquidity toolkit used in October 2026
capsules.body: The RBI combined a 25 bp repo hike to 5.50%, the 99% daily CRR floor, VRRR auctions and a Rs 25,000 crore OMO sale on 13 October 2026 to drain a surplus put at Rs 3.88 lakh crore on 8 October.

capsules.subject: Banking Regulation
capsules.title: Why the RBI tightened liquidity in October 2026
capsules.body: Surplus liquidity fell from about Rs 11 lakh crore in early September to Rs 462 billion by 26 October 2026, and overnight borrowing rates rose close to the top of the monetary policy range. Reporting on 29 October 2026 said the squeeze followed RBI measures to defend the rupee as it approached a record low, including raising the minimum daily CRR maintenance to 99 per cent from the fortnight beginning 16 October and capping liquidity support at Rs 1.5 lakh crore. Analysts described the tightness as intentional: dearer rupee borrowing raises the cost of hedging against further rupee weakness.
